source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
As [Declare Battle Formations](vsdata:core-rule/chapter-approved.declare-battle-formations) begins, this model has to join a **COMMAND SQUAD** unit of your army, and each **COMMAND SQUAD** can take at most one **LOYAL PROTECTOR** model. From then until the battle ends, this model is part of that unit, whose [Starting Strength](vsdata:core-rule/units-and-models) rises to match. If it cannot join a **COMMAND SQUAD**, it is left out of the battle, and is treated as **destroyed**.

While joined to a unit, this model can [embark](vsdata:core-rule/embarking) in every **TRANSPORT** its unit can embark in, and counts as 3 models toward the [transport capacity](vsdata:core-rule/transport-capacity).

This model cannot be your **WARLORD**.

detail.trigger: start of Declare Battle Formations step
